name: Statlog Shuttle Radiator Position Benchmark
description: The Statlog Shuttle dataset consists of 58,000 instances describing NASA Space Shuttle radiator thermal loop configurations across 9 numerical attributes. Featuring severe class imbalance across 7 radiator state classes, it is widely utilized for anomaly detection and imbalanced learning research.
